map.油温烹饪指南 使用指南: Oil Temperature Cooking Guide User Guide
map.中餐油温指南，按油温档位查看温度范围、特征与适用烹饪方式(三四成至九十成)，辅助: A Chinese cooking oil temperature guide listing the temperature range, characteristics and suitable cooking methods for each heat level (30-40% to 90% hot), to help control the heat.
map.滑炒肉丝、上浆鱼片需低温（三四成热约 120–150℃）下锅，锁水嫩滑不粘；油温: Stir-fried shredded pork and battered fish slices need low temperature (30-40% hot, about 120-150C) so the water stays locked and the texture stays tender and non-sticky; too hot burns the outside while leaving the inside raw.
map.炸制（五六十成热约 160–190℃）按炸不同食材分阶段，先中温定型再升温逼油，: Frying (50-60% hot, about 160-190C) stages by ingredient, first setting the shape at medium temperature then raising the temperature to drive out oil, giving a crisp outside and tender inside.
map.爆香葱姜蒜、炝锅用七八成热（约 200℃ 上下），入料即响、香气迸发但不焦；超过: For fragrant aromatics such as scallion, ginger and garlic, use 70-80% heat (around 200C); the ingredients sizzle and release aroma without burning, while going hotter causes smoke and bitterness.
map.：竹筷插入油中，四周冒细密小泡（约 120–150℃）即三四成热，适合滑炒上浆；: Insert bamboo chopsticks into the oil; fine bubbles around them (about 120-150C) means 30-40% heat, suitable for stir-frying battered ingredients. Large vigorous bubbles with faint blue smoke (200C and above) is too hot; remove from the heat and cool before adding the food.
map.几成油温对应多少度？: What temperature does each heat level correspond to?
map.大致：三四成 120–150℃、五六成 160–180℃、七八成 190–220: Roughly: 30-40% hot is 120-150C, 50-60% is 160-180C, 70-80% is 190-220C, and 90% is 230C and above near smoking; smoke points differ by oil, so judge by observation.
map.为什么滑炒要低温？: Why does stir-frying need low temperature?
map.上浆食材低温下锅淀粉糊化形成保护膜、锁住水分，高温会瞬间结壳致粘锅且内部不熟。: Starchy coatings added before cooking form a protective film during gelatinization at low temperature that locks in moisture; high temperature crusts over instantly, causing sticking and an undercooked interior.
map.油冒烟了还能用吗？: Can the oil still be used if it is smoking?
map.冒烟说明已达烟点，继续加热会产生有害物质并带焦苦味，应离火降温或换油，勿强行下料: Smoking means the smoke point has been reached; continued heating produces harmful substances and a bitter burnt taste, so remove from the heat to cool or change the oil, and do not force the food in.
